List the templates a new paywall or onboarding flow can start from, with what each holds and the
slugs of the products it sells. A paywall made from one needs products with those slugs, or others
chosen in the dashboard, before it can be deployed.

Usage:
  voidhash paywall template list [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --kind <paywall|onboarding|feedback|reactivation|custom>
                           Only the templates for flows of this purpose
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash paywall template list
  voidhash paywall template list --kind onboarding -q
